EXTRAORDINARY
(Published by Authority)
PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No. : 8/3/5/3/9. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4-3/9/2017/WS/523.

I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the lands shown below which are required for a public purpose. Description of the Lands to be Acquired: The allotmentof land described below containing in extent 0.2799 Hectare, depicted as lot No. 357 in Final Village Plan No. 25, prepared by Surveyor General, situated at Rajjammana Village in Gampahasiya Pattuwa Minor Division of Matale Divisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central province:
01. Lot No. 357 Name of land: Rajjammana Plantation alias Rajjammana Special Project Colony; Original Claimant: K.A. Premawathi.
On the North by: Lot Nos. 148 and 147; On the East by: Lot Nos. 147 and 349; On the South by: Lot Nos. 351 and 132; On the West by: Lot No. 132.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Matale Divisional Secretariat on the 30th day of May 2019 at 11.00 a.m. and hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 23rd of May, 2019 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. K.P.K.L.P. MADHUWANTHI, Divisional Secretary, Matale . Divisional Secretariat, Matale. 29th April, 2019. 05-312

CORRIGENDAR
Notice under Section 7
My No. : ඇȝාෙɢ/50/5/01/04. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: LD/05/2006/E/354.

I hereby give notice for publishing again under Section 7 as the inquiry had not been held on the prescribed date noticed in the Gazette No. 1833/22 dated 24.10.2013 to be present at the Divisional Secretariat, Elapatha at 3.00 p.m. on the 27th November, 2013, all persons who claim ownership, rights or other interests under Sub-section 1 of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964, as the Republic of Sri Lanka intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land to be acquired : The land called Hakawathugoda Hena 0.0642 ha. in extent and depicted in the folio No. 31 of F.V.P. 38 and Lot No. 558 of the Supplement No. 22 in accordance with the Primary Plan No. R/ELP/2008/322 situated in the Village Niriella in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Elapatha,
Nawadun Korale in Ratnapura District, Sabaragamuwa Province.

All persons who claim ownership, right or are interested in the aforementioned land should be appear by personally or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me, at the Divisional Secretariat Elapatha at 10.00 a.m. on the 3rd July, 2019. Further notify to me in writing (in duplicate) before the 17th June, 2019, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of calculation of such amount. Documents should be submitted to me at the inquiry to prove the interests. S.A. DILRUK, Divisional Secretary, Elapatha . At the Elapatha Divisional Secretariat, 29th April, 2019. 05-313
